tarot.label: Online tarot
tarot.line: Drawing cards is free, and so is the meaning of each card. Read these cards against your matter, then come back when it's due to ask about the outcome.

jieqian.label: Temple lot reading
jieqian.line: Drew a temple lot at the temple? Enter the lot number or photograph the poem to read it in plain language, then place that lot against your matter.

jiaobei.label: Online moon blocks and temple lots
jiaobei.line: Cast once per matter, or follow the temple's order: ask, draw a lot, confirm the number. Free with sign-in.

bazi.label: BaZi (Four Pillars)
bazi.line: Sign in to set up your chart. The plain-language reading, in-depth report, and questions about this chart need a Pass or membership. The Partner portrait is bought separately.
bazi.priceNote: Natal report: Pass / membership; Luck cycles and yearly luck: membership

ziwei.label: Zi Wei Dou Shu
ziwei.line: Sign in to set up the twelve palaces, stars, and four transformations. The plain-language reading, in-depth report, and questions about this chart need a Pass or membership.
ziwei.priceNote: Natal report: Pass / membership; Major periods and yearly luck: membership

xingpan.label: Birth chart
xingpan.line: Sign in to set up your natal chart. The plain-language reading, in-depth report, and questions about this chart need a Pass or membership.
xingpan.priceNote: Natal report: Pass / membership; This month's transits: membership

zhengyuan.label: Partner portrait
zhengyuan.line: From your BaZi, a sketch of the kind of person who tends to end up with you: looks, how you get along, where you meet. The first line is free.

hepan.label: Compatibility reading
hepan.line: How two people get along, read through BaZi, Zi Wei, and birth charts together. The overview is free, and you can ask them to enter their own birth details.

nianshu.label: Three-in-one yearbook
nianshu.line: BaZi, Zi Wei, and birth chart read together for the year: overview, four seasons, each area of life, with key months marked.
nianshu.priceNote: 20% off for members; early-bird price Nov 1–Jan 31 (solar calendar)

today-qian.label: Daily temple lot
today-qian.line: One lot a day, for how to look at today. Members read the full text.

name.label: Name analysis
name.line: Look up a name's character meanings, pronunciation, Kangxi stroke counts, and five grids. Add a birth date to compare with the favorable elements in your BaZi.
name.priceNote: Baby naming / renaming reference: bought separately, 20% off for members

xunwu.label: Lost something?
xunwu.line: Tap three times and roll three dice to see which direction to search first and what kind of place to check, with steps for reporting a loss, freezing a card, and locating a device. No sign-in needed.

dream.label: Dream meanings
dream.line: Two hundred common dreams: what the old sayings say and how to read them in plain terms. If something from a dream stays on your mind, you can cast a hexagram about it.

taisui.label: Tai Sui conflict lookup
taisui.line: Which zodiac signs clash with Tai Sui in 2027, and how to honor Tai Sui by custom.

huangli.label: Almanac
huangli.line: Today's do's and don'ts, clashes, and solar terms, with a page for every day.

zeri.label: Date picking
zeri.line: Moving, opening a business, marrying, traveling… pick a matter and see which days suit it.
zeri.priceNote: View a whole year, filtered by your BaZi: membership

yunshi.label: Daily fortune
yunshi.line: The twelve zodiac animals: each one's rhythm today, and what suits it.
yunshi.priceNote: Your day, worked out from your BaZi (Four Pillars): membership

bmg.label: Your life hexagram
bmg.line: 12 questions, about 2 minutes, no birth date: which of the 64 hexagrams matches how you act, handle feelings, see things and get along with people.

ziwei.label: 紫微斗数

yunshi.label: 毎日の運勢
